title: I get a 'duplicate tax number' error when adding a new customer
description: I'm creating a new customer record but it says 'Tax number already exists in another record.' However, I don't see any record with that number.

worklogs.description: Found the same tax number on an old (deactivated) customer record.
Merged the two records with the Customer Merge tool, added the new contact information.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The old deactivated record was merged, and all history was transferred onto the new record. You can see it in the CRM now.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: My customer is showing up, and the past business records are here too. Thanks.

resolutionNote: The two customer records (old + new) were merged into a single record with the Customer Merge tool.

csat.comment: It was important to me not to lose the historical data either, thanks.
